author: ShinobiPig
body:
Again, I have been banned for "Ban Evasion". I have already been unbanned before. I don't understand why I keep being banned. IXpig is not linked with this account. I do not have the same IP as a previous staff member has seen. I keep getting banned and I see it as unfair. I am being discriminated against for being a "Pig" and for apparently evading a ban. I have done nothing wrong and I refuse to be banned. I was fine with the first time but this time it has gotten on my nerves. I do not deserve this type of treatment. Unban me please and just stop banning me. I feel the need of a compensation, for I have been wrongly accused twice and I will not want a third. This is unjust and unreasonable. The staff member should have already read my first ban appeal and try to avoid banning me. This is all I have to say, I will send some pictures as evidence.

-ShinobiPig, an upset member.
